title: Wonder
author: R. J. Palacio
summary: Auggie Pullman, who was born with a facial difference and has been homeschooled, starts fifth grade at a mainstream school. The story is told by several voices, including his classmates and his sister.
readIf: you want an uplifting, kind story about empathy that works for both younger and older readers.
skipIf: you prefer subtle, complex fiction or dislike messages that are stated openly.

pairings.reason: A classic about friendship and kindness that also has a gentle emotional punch.
Another middle-grade book about a boy who finds friendship in an unwelcoming place.
